My best options are w and y, both offering a value of $64, and I am top priority at both. Since most students favor y, w is likely to be less competitive than y. However, if I rank y first and it's oversubscribed, I could end up unmatched. w offers a guaranteed spot, but potentially at the cost of a slightly lower overall outcome if I could have gotten z.

Given the information about the applicant pool, I believe my best strategy is to rank y first, then z, then w, then x. This allows me to pursue the most popular school, and my rank at y is 1, so I have a good chance. If y doesn't work out, I can fall back on z, which is my next best value, though my rank is lower. w is a safe fallback, and x is my least preferred option.
